description: This file is a server entry point for a Node.js application that sets up server listening, manages a PID file for singleton behavior, and handles process signals and errors. It initializes environment variables, connects to MongoDB, and starts an HTTP server with health check endpoints.

methods.name: ensurePidFileGuard
methods.description: Ensures only one server instance runs by checking and managing a PID file.

methods.name: writePidFile
methods.description: Writes the current process PID to the PID file.

methods.name: removePidFile
methods.description: Removes the PID file if it exists.

methods.name: startServerStrict
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server, manages lifecycle events, and handles shutdown procedures.
